blind.description: A dark stone architectural flying buttress consisting of a vertical rectangular pier with moulded caps and plinths, adorned on the side with a carved relief of a spider web and a spider with golden markings. A curved arch arm extends downward from near the top of the pier, banded with decorative stone collars, and terminates at a stepped low base plinth. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted stone texturing, sitting flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A straight linear structure showing the rectangular top of the main pillar connecting into a narrow curved arch arm that terminates in a small stepped rectangular footing.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 6 ft tall), with an arch span extending roughly 4 to 5 ft long.

notes: Arch span is longer than catalog proportions but reads clearly as a flying buttress
